name: DeleteExcelWorksheetNode
label: Delete Excel Worksheet
description: Deletes a specific worksheet from the specified Excel Workbook.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: The Excel Workbook from which the worksheet will be deleted.

fields.name: DeleteMode
fields.label: Delete Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to identify the worksheet to delete (by Name or by Index).

selectOptions.label: Name
selectOptions.description: Deletes the worksheet by its name.

selectOptions.label: Index
selectOptions.description: Deletes the worksheet by its index.

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet to delete.

fields.name: WorksheetIndex
fields.label: Worksheet Index
fields.description: The index of the worksheet to delete (1-based).
